How BLACKPINK, TWICE & IZ*ONE Become TOP 3 Girl Group?
BLACKPINK, IZ*ONE & TWICE Make Korean History With New Joint Chart Record

BLACKPINK make huge waves for girl groups this year with their highly anticipated debut studio album, titled The Album. After smashing first week sales records, the group quickly became the first Korean girl group in history to surpass 1 million sales with just one album. By the end of 2020, BLACKPINK racked up a staggering 1,725,000 sales in total.

IZ*ONE became the girl group record-holder for highest first week album sales with BLOOM*IZ early in 2020. They went on to release another two albums last year: Oneiric Diary and One Reeler, both of which sold incredibly well. Taking the sales from all three albums into account, IZ*ONE reached 1,545,00 sales in 2020.

TWICE had plenty of chart dominating moments of their own this year. Prior to the release of The Album, they became the girl group sales record holders with More & More. They’re also the girl group with the highest total album sales in history. Between More & More and Eyes Wide Open last year, TWICE sold 1,300,000 albums in total.

snippet.description:
How BLACKPINK, TWICE & IZ*ONE Become TOP 3 Girl Group?
BLACKPINK, IZ*ONE & TWICE Make Korean History With New Joint Chart Record

BLACKPINK make huge waves for girl groups this year with their highly anticipated debut studio album, titled The Album. After smashing first week sales records, the group quickly became the first Korean girl group in history to surpass 1 million sales with just one album. By the end of 2020, BLACKPINK racked up a staggering 1,725,000 sales in total.

IZ*ONE became the girl group record-holder for highest first week album sales with BLOOM*IZ early in 2020. They went on to release another two albums last year: Oneiric Diary and One Reeler, both of which sold incredibly well. Taking the sales from all three albums into account, IZ*ONE reached 1,545,00 sales in 2020.

TWICE had plenty of chart dominating moments of their own this year. Prior to the release of The Album, they became the girl group sales record holders with More & More. They’re also the girl group with the highest total album sales in history. Between More & More and Eyes Wide Open last year, TWICE sold 1,300,000 albums in total.
